2014_spells.ensnaring-strike.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, a writhing mass of thorny vines appears at the point of impact, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained by the magical vines until the spell ends. A Large or larger creature has advantage on this saving throw. While restrained by this spell, the target takes 1d6 piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.
2014_spells.ensnaring-strike.effectSumma: Deal 1d6 piercing damage to a target within Self
2014_spells.ensnaring-strike.fullDescrip: Using 1 bonus action, the next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, a writhing mass of thorny vines appears at the point of impact, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained by the magical vines until the spell ends. While restrained by this spell, the target takes 1d6 piercing damage at the start of each of its turns; A Large or larger creature has advantage on this saving throw; If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st. The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, a writhing mass of thorny vines appears at the point of impact, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw; roll a d20, add the STR modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC or be restrained by the magical vines until the spell ends; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
